record.question: The primary occupation of the people in the Indus Valley Civilization was
record.explanation: Answer A: Agriculture. Archaeological evidence shows agriculture was a central subsistence activity in the Indus civilization. Reference: https://asi.nic.in/harappan-civilization/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
